entries.zh: 乖巧机敏、聪明懂事；兼取「明智稳重」之义（对译 sabio prudente）
entries.en: wise and prudent; clever, sensible, well-behaved
entries.notes: L 栏 prudense/prudente 拼写存疑，当作 prudente「明智」，不影响释义。

entries.zh: 皎：皎洁明亮；此处喻心智明澈、能察知他人心思
entries.en: bright, clear; figuratively clear of mind, discerning another's thoughts
entries.notes: L 栏 ſentiende/entiende 存疑，义为「领会心思」；皎借指心智明澈。

entries.zh: 洁：洁净、纯洁；此处指心地明净、心思透亮
entries.en: clean, pure; figuratively clear and pure in mind
entries.notes: L 栏 ſentiende/entiende 存疑；洁取「心地明净」引申义。

entries.zh: 烛理之人：明察事理、思路清晰的人
entries.en: one who discerns principles; a person of clear understanding

entries.zh: 「獻」当为「賢」之借字：贤能干练；本义为进献
entries.en: worthy and capable (apparent graphic variant of 賢 'worthy'); literally 'to offer, present'
entries.notes: M 栏声调号 T99 污损，且「獻」为「賢」借字系依音义推断。

entries.zh: 贤：有德行、有才干；贤明
entries.en: virtuous and able; worthy, wise

entries.zh: 才：才能、才华；有才能的人
entries.en: talent, ability; a talented person

entries.zh: 俊：才智出众、容貌俊秀；此处实指「俊士」，才德出众之士
entries.en: outstanding in talent and looks; handsome, gracious (Sp. gracioso)
entries.notes: L 栏 gacionos/gracionos 存疑（当作 gracioso）；M 栏两音节合「俊士」。

entries.zh: 造：创制、造就（成全成才）之义；其后所附词组原稿污损，义难确指
entries.en: to make, create; to train to accomplishment (as in 造就); following phrase smudged, unreadable
entries.notes: T99 污损且 M 栏后附词组多字带问号，无法定夺。

entries.zh: 贤智：贤明而有智谋，才智兼备；后接词组污损难辨
entries.en: wise and intelligent; a sage of talent and learning; following phrase partly smudged
entries.notes: M 栏两处 T99，后接词组切分不明。

entries.zh: 贤才：德才兼备之人、贤能之士
entries.en: a man of virtue and talent; worthy, capable person

entries.zh: 贤士：贤德有学之士、贤明读书人
entries.en: a worthy scholar; sage, virtuous man of learning

entries.zh: 文学：学问、文章之学（古义，兼指博学之人）
entries.en: learning, letters, scholarship; by extension a learned man

entries.zh: 传学：传授、传承学问；师承所得之学
entries.en: to teach and transmit learning; learning handed down from one's teachers
entries.notes: M 栏音写与「傳」字读音不合，或为别字；释义从 H、L 栏。

entries.zh: 文墨：笔墨文章之学；指能文识字、会写会读
entries.en: letters, literary skill (pen and ink); literate, book-learned

entries.zh: 腹内有（学）：肚里有墨水，喻胸中有学识
entries.en: to have learning inside the belly; learned, full of knowledge

entries.zh: 字面「腰有膏」，与西义「博学」不合；疑为「腹有稿（腹中有文章学问）」一类之讹，释义存疑
entries.en: lit. 'fat about the waist'; does not fit Sp. 'learned, much studied' — likely a corruption for 'having drafts/learning in the belly'; uncertain
entries.notes: H 栏「腰有膏」与 L 栏义相抵触，另有 [疑:vǔ/ū]，无法定夺。

entries.zh: 经天纬地：经纬天地，形容治国安邦的雄才大略、绝顶才学
entries.en: to order heaven and earth; prodigious statecraft and consummate learning

entries.zh: 见识：见闻阅历、眼光与见解
entries.en: knowledge and experience; insight, judgment

entries.zh: 才学：才华与学问
entries.en: talent and learning
entries.notes: 第二音节声调号 T99 污损；[疑:學/孝] 依 M 栏判作「學」，释义仍稳。

entries.zh: 圣贤：圣人与贤者，德才兼备之至者（明智而圣善）
entries.en: sages and worthies; the wise and holy (wise and saint)

entries.zh: 规模大：格局气度宏大、规模宏伟（此处状才略器局之大）
entries.en: grand in scale and scope; of a person, great in capacity and measure
